model.name: H3 Omni — Pruned
model.description: Recommended lighter MiniMax H3 Omni model. Ordered image, video, and audio references can guide identity, appearance, motion, scenes, voices, or sound. Multi-window sequence supports AI-planned or manual per-window prompts while carrying recent motion and synchronized stereo audio with the same canonical references. H3 LoRAs, including Turbo, are converted automatically when needed.
